title: Custom American Football on Usa Flag Background Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with the custom football comforter set from Jeminise. This sporty bedding features a striking football design on a USA flag background with wooden planks, making it the perfect statement piece for football players, fans, and coaches alike. Crafted for exceptional comfort and personalized style, it brings the energy of the game right to your space.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features two custom text inputs to add your own name and number for a truly unique and custom look.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Versatile Options: Available as a lightweight duvet cover (without filling) or an all-in-one cozy comforter set.
  • Included Components: Includes 1 duvet cover or comforter, with options to add matching pillowcases and flat sheet covers.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle, dry on low heat or air dry without heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Love Football Art
Pattern American Flag
Theme Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
